import numpy as np
def equation(t, x, v, params):
    p = params
    return (p[0] + p[1]*t + p[2]*x + p[3]*x**3 + p[4]*v**3 + p[5]*t*v**3
            + p[6]/v + p[7]*np.sqrt(x)/v + p[8]/x + p[9]*np.sin(0.32*t)*v**3)
